# `kernel/agent/SemanticShortcutMap.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/agent/SemanticShortcutMap.js`

Rebuildable, source-text-free semantic navigation over verified projections. The map is an accelerator, never mutation or continuation authority. Code ranges resolve through the existing revision-bound ctx registry. External targets are represented only by cryptographic references and must be reconciled against their authoritative ledger before a tool is invoked.

## Functions

### `async buildSemanticShortcutLegend()`

### `async buildSemanticShortcutMap({ projectIndex = null, scopeHeads = {}, artifactRevisions = [], workspaceRevisions = [], mounts = [], osCapabilities = [], skills = [], modelRoutes = [], tasks = [], scenes = [], researchSources = [], researchClaims = [], receipts = [], resume = null, } = {})`

Build one deterministic map from an existing project-index projection and optional exact-scope metadata. Optional scopes never contain source bodies.

### `resolveSemanticShortcut(map, shortcut, { expectedMapId = '', expectedSourceHead = '', } = {})`

Resolve one shortcut only when the caller's map/source expectations match.

### `routeSemanticShortcuts(map, { from, to, direction = 'any', expectedMapId = '', expectedSourceHead = '', maxHops = MAX_ROUTE_HOPS, } = {})`

Return a deterministic shortest route and the immediately useful next hop. Routes are navigation hints only and never authorize the represented tools.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
